question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Malati has a difficult job, but she does it __good__.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. **'well'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Well**" is the correct **adverb** to describe **the performance of an action**, in this case, how Malati does her job.
